summary: The paper presents a machine-checked, zero-floating-point formalization and exact-rational certificate auditing framework for A. C. Cem Say's polynomial-time quantum space lower bounds. It implements an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel with zero errors, warnings, or choice axioms, alongside a pure-stdlib Python verifier auditing 16 canonical certificates across four exact modes.
weaknesses: Presentation is dense and relies heavily on external definitions from Say's recent work.
